tools.name: search-products
tools.description: Search Printing Labs' live corporate-gifting catalog (custom apparel, drinkware, welcome kits, bundles). Filter by free-text keyword, exact category, maximum unit price in INR, or bundles only. Returns matches with canonical product page URLs.

tools.name: get-product-details
tools.description: Full public details for one product or bundle by its permalink slug (from search-products results) or numeric id: description, pricing, bulk-discount tiers, GST rate, minimum order quantity, stock signal, and page URL.

tools.name: list-product-categories
tools.description: All Printing Labs catalog categories with live product counts and their canonical category page URLs, plus the preset-bundle count.

tools.name: get-brand-store-pricing
tools.description: What a Brand Store costs: the one-time setup fee and the monthly plans (seats, features, price). These are PLATFORM fees for running a private branded storefront — the merchandise inside it is priced separately per product, via calculate-bulk-price. Never present a plan price as a per-item price.

tools.name: get-company-info
tools.description: Verified facts about Printing Labs: services, fulfillment regions, budget-tier collections, seasonal gifting hubs, machine-readable resources, and how to contact or request a corporate quote.

tools.name: calculate-bulk-price
tools.description: Compute the effective bulk price for a given product and quantity: applies the product's quantity-discount tiers and GST, validates the minimum order quantity, and shows the next discount tier. Indicative pricing — final quotes come from the sales team.

tools.name: list-catalogs
tools.description: The downloadable PDF catalogue library: every published catalogue with its title, description, page count, file size, and direct PDF URL.

tools.name: get-site-info
tools.description: Look up how Printing Labs actually works: answers from the published FAQ, what each in-house tool does (Mockup Studio, Brand Stores, Campaign Planner, Build Box, Swag Drop), the list of public pages, and headline return/shipping/terms/privacy facts with the page carrying the binding version. tools.name: get-product-mockup
tools.description: Get a working Mockup Studio deep link for a product, so the user can upload their logo, position it in the real print zone and download a free mockup — no sign-in needed. Use when someone asks how their logo would look on an item.

tools.description: List the signed-in customer's own orders with statuses. Requires a portal personal token on the connection (Authorization: Bearer plt_… — minted at printinglabs.com → Profile → AI assistant access). Without one, the tool returns connection instructions.

tools.description: List the signed-in customer's own Zoho invoices with totals, balances and signed PDF links. Requires the portal personal token (see my-orders).

tools.name: reorder

Creates a repeat-order enquiry — the team confirms pricing before production; nothing is charged automatically. tools.description: Submit a corporate quote request to the Printing Labs sales team on the user's behalf. Creates a real lead: the team receives it instantly (CRM + email + WhatsApp) and the requester gets a confirmation email. Only submit with the user's explicit consent and their real contact details.

tools.name: cancel-meeting
tools.description: Cancel a meeting you booked earlier in this conversation. Requires the manageToken returned by book-meeting — the same token that powers the cancel link in the customer's confirmation email. Removes the Google Calendar event and notifies both sides.

tools.name: request-callback

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search-products, get-product-details, list-product-categories, list-catalogs, get-seo-health, search-guides, get-guide, book-meeting · Private data: get-brand-store-pricing, get-company-info, list-catalogs, my-orders, my-invoices, reorder, request-quote, cancel-meeting, raise-complaint, book-meeting, create-onboarding-drop · Public sink: get-product-mockup, request-quote, cancel-meeting, request-callback, raise-complaint, track-order, create-onboarding-drop · Destructive: get-site-info, get-seo-health, create-onboarding-drop.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search-products, get-product-details, list-product-categories, list-catalogs, get-seo-health, search-guides, get-guide, book-meeting · Private data: get-brand-store-pricing, get-company-info, list-catalogs, my-orders, my-invoices, reorder, request-quote, cancel-meeting, raise-complaint, book-meeting, create-onboarding-drop · Public sink: get-product-mockup, request-quote, cancel-meeting, request-callback, raise-complaint, track-order, create-onboarding-drop · Destructive: get-site-info, get-seo-health, create-onboarding-drop

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
